title: Selecting a game server
summary: Transition from the Login connection to the Game connection.
description:
# Server selection

1. Complete Login Server authentication.
2. Request the server list.
3. Process {{link packet:server-list}}.
4. Select a server and request admission.
5. Retain the returned session values.
6. Start {{link scenario:game-connection}}.

Session values connect the two client connections. Internal Login↔Game communication belongs to the server implementation and is described separately.
